content:
required
QueryId obtained when creating a query under Create Query.
Example: "q1xx2xx3".
optional
Cursor position returned by the last request. Should be used instead
of skip. cursor currently supports sort by with createdAt, pid,
processStartTime
optional
Limit number of returned items (1-1000). Example: "10".
optional
Skip first number of items (0-1000). To iterate over more than 1000
items,  use "cursor". Example: "150".
optional
Events sorted by field. Example: "createdAt".
optional
Event sorting order. Example: "asc".
optional
Create a sub query to run on the data that was already pulled
